units.source_text: 而且，还得考虑量的问题吧？

en.t: And besides, you have to consider the question of quantity too, don't you?
... If the quantity is different, naturally the pressure is different too ...

units.source_text: 压力不同，重量与阻力的平衡，当然也会发生变化。

en.t: When the pressure is different, the balance between weight and resistance will of course change as well.

units.source_text: 沙粒子的构造也许也有问题。

en.t: There may also be an issue with the structure of the sand particles.

units.source_text: 就拿红土来说，自然开采的红土，与填土的红土，

en.t: Take red clay, for example: naturally excavated red clay and red clay used as fill,

units.source_text: 抗压能力可是完全不一样的。

en.t: have completely different resistance to pressure.

units.source_text: 进一步嘛，还得考虑湿度……

en.t: To go a step further, you also have to consider humidity ...

units.source_text: 也就是说，模型很可能是别的法则在起作用。

en.t: In other words, it is quite possible that a different set of laws is at work in the model.
